items.title: Manual vs. automated recovery time, as the pipeline grows
items.description: A manual rollback means someone re-runs the deploy steps by hand, one at a time — the more steps the process has, the longer that takes. An automated rollback runs a fixed script regardless of how many steps the pipeline has. Drag the step count to see how the gap grows.

params.name: stepCount
params.label: Number of steps in the deploy process
